sloka: विप्रकार प्रियः क्षुद्रो वर दान बल अन्वितः ।परिक्रामति यः सर्वाम्ल् लोकान् सम्तापयन् प्रजाः ॥६-३७-३०॥।।
transliteration: viprakāra priyaḥ kṣudro vara dāna bala anvitaḥ ।parikrāmati yaḥ sarvāml lokān samtāpayan prajāḥ ॥6-37-30॥।।

translations.english: "That Ravana who is harming Daityas and Danavas, and great souls following wicked practices and armed by the boons is oppressing all people wandering all over. I, with Lakshmana, have determined to persecute and kill him and force my entry to the north gate."
translations.hindi: सताने वाले, नीच, वरदान से बलवान, सब लोकों में घूमने बाले, समस्त प्रजाजनों को सन्तप्त करने वाले
